description: WAI-ARIA Feed timeline of user actions. Author renders <article data-activity> children timestamped with data-time or an authored <time datetime> child; component decorates with relative-time badges, optional date grouping, optional infinite-scroll sentinel (aria-busy + done() handshake), and per-entry avatar / icon left-rail.

attributes.name: data-group
attributes.description: none (default) | day | week — date headings between entries

attributes.name: data-infinite
attributes.description: Adds an IntersectionObserver sentinel; emits activity-feed:load-more when reached and sets aria-setsize="-1" on entries. Remove the attribute to end the feed (sentinel removed, real aria-setsize, aria-busy cleared).

attributes.name: data-empty-text
attributes.description: Text shown when the feed has zero entries (default "No recent activity")

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Managed: "feed" while the feed has entries, "group" while empty (so the empty-state text is a valid child). An author-set role other than feed/group is left alone.

attributes.name: aria-busy
attributes.description: Managed: "true" from activity-feed:load-more until detail.done() is called, new entries arrive, or data-infinite is removed.

events.name: activity-feed:load-more
events.description: Fires when the infinite-scroll sentinel comes into view (at most one outstanding request). detail.done() ends the busy state and re-arms the sentinel; appending entries or removing data-infinite also ends it.

properties.name: addEntry
properties.description: Append (or prepend) an entry from data

properties.name: entries
properties.description: Snapshot array of the current entry elements (a new array on each read, not live)

properties.name: loading
properties.description: Read-only. True while a load-more is outstanding (mirrors aria-busy)

childAttributes.name: data-activity
childAttributes.description: Marks an article as a feed entry

childAttributes.name: data-time
childAttributes.description: ISO-8601 timestamp; renders as relative time. Alternatively author a direct-child <time datetime> (works without JS and is upgraded in place); data-time wins if both are present

childAttributes.name: data-activity-avatar
childAttributes.description: Avatar URL — renders <user-avatar> in the left rail

childAttributes.name: data-activity-icon
childAttributes.description: icon-wc name — renders <icon-wc> in the left rail (alternative to avatar)
